headline_marked: Messi's next move: [[Lionel Messi acquires Spanish club CD Eldense]] as playing days end
headline: Messi's next move: Lionel Messi acquires Spanish club CD Eldense as playing days end
summary: The football legend is building a football ownership empire across Spain, Uruguay, and the US, focusing on youth development.
details: Lionel Messi is preparing for life after football by investing in club ownership. The 39-year-old star has recently completed the acquisition of Spanish second-tier club CD Eldense, pending regulatory approval.

This adds to his growing portfolio, which includes UE Cornella, a Catalan fifth-tier side he purchased in April. According to BBC Sport, Eldense is intended to be the flagship of his operation, with Cornella serving as a talent breeding ground.

Messi has expressed a lack of interest in coaching, stating that he prefers owning clubs and helping young players develop. He is already a partner in Deportivo LSM in Uruguay, a youth-focused project with Luis Suarez.
His Inter Miami contract also includes a future stake in the MLS club upon his retirement. This would give him ownership interest in the team he has helped transform globally since 2023.

Beyond ownership, Messi has launched the Messi Cup, an under-16 tournament in Miami. The competition is expanding this month to include 16 academies, including those of Barcelona, Arsenal, and Chelsea.
Messi is also diversifying his business interests into hotels, property, and restaurants. He has admitted to being a beginner in the business world and expressed a strong desire to continue learning.
caption:
Forget coaching—Messi is building a football empire. ⚽️

Lionel Messi is preparing for life after football by investing in club ownership. The 39-year-old star has recently completed the acquisition of Spanish second-tier club CD Eldense, pending regulatory approval.

This adds to his growing portfolio, which includes UE Cornella, a Catalan fifth-tier side he purchased in April. According to BBC Sport, Eldense is intended to be the flagship of his operation, with Cornella serving as a talent breeding ground.

Messi has expressed a lack of interest in coaching, stating that he prefers owning clubs and helping young players develop. He is already a partner in Deportivo LSM in Uruguay, a youth-focused project with Luis Suarez.

His Inter Miami contract also includes a future stake in the MLS club upon his retirement. This would give him ownership interest in the team he has helped transform globally since 2023.

Beyond ownership, Messi has launched the Messi Cup, an under-16 tournament in Miami. The competition is expanding this month to include 16 academies, including those of Barcelona, Arsenal, and Chelsea.

Messi is also diversifying his business interests into hotels, property, and restaurants. He has admitted to being a beginner in the business world and expressed a strong desire to continue learning.

#Messi #Football #CD Eldense #InterMiami #SportsBusiness

Source: bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: High Court: [[Husbands must pay overdue dowery immediately]] upon wife's demand
headline: High Court: Husbands must pay overdue dowery immediately upon wife's demand
summary: The court ruled that wives no longer need to wait for divorce or the husband's death to claim their overdue dowery (denmohor).
details: The High Court has delivered a landmark ruling stating that any overdue dowery (denmohor) must be paid to the wife immediately upon her request, regardless of the marriage status.
caption:
Wives no longer have to wait for divorce or death to claim their dowery.

The High Court has delivered a landmark ruling stating that any overdue dowery (denmohor) must be paid to the wife immediately upon her request, regardless of the marriage status.

#Bangladesh #HighCourt #WomensRights #LegalNews #Justice

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
